name: seranking
description: Connect SE Ranking to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use SE Ranking MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect SE Ranking to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with sEO data and site audits using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my SE Ranking workspace.
Find anything in SE Ranking that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review sEO data and site audits in SE Ranking.
